correctness.rationale: Directly deriving monotonicity from meet preservation and the center-plateau property from the Pos/Con axioms gives a necessary-and-sufficient classification for each odd chain. Two disjoint weakly increasing sequence enumerations yield all four exact binomial formulas. Consecutive coefficient ratios bound the conditional tails geometrically, proving total-variation convergence; Stirling gives the sharp exponentially small failure rate. Full-function direct checks for m=1,2 and exhaustive monotone-map checks for m=1..4 reproduced the identities. Finite tests are corroboration rather than infinite proof.

value.rationale: The modal Kleene class introduced in 2026 makes the total count of admissible unary operations on canonical finite chains a natural, motivated exact invariant. The theorem completely enumerates every odd chain, four normal/center-preserving subclasses and the exact defect-height profile. It identifies quantitatively that almost every admissible operation fixes the negation center despite no such axiom, while the rare displacements obey a geometric law. The one-case size-three count and the qualitative plateau corollary are credited as prior information.
